title: Cylinder current X ↦ X ∘ S from the bounded-current constructor, with mass bound and additivity
statement: Notation: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} for t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N; Jv := ι(0, v) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) := TestFormOn univ m and 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) := GeometricCurrentOn univ m (forms and currents on all of ℝ^P = Euclid P); M(T) := T.mass = T.massOn univ; spt T := T.support. Assume (MSB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and c ∈ ℝ with |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, one has |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X).toReal; and (BC): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, every ℝ-linear T₀ : 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) → ℝ and C ∈ ℝ such that |T₀(ω)| ≤ C·c whenever ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), c ∈ ℝ and |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x, there is T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with T(ω) = T₀(ω) for all ω and M(T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C. Then for all N, k ∈ ℕ and every ℝ-linear S : 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) satisfying (iii) [for every ω and c ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y ∈ ℝ^{N+1}, |S(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x ∈ ℝ^N], there is a map cyl : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) such that (a) for every X with M(X) < ∞: cyl(X)(ω) = X(S(ω)) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and M(cyl(X)) ≤ M(X); (b) cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) for all X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞ and M(Y) < ∞ (X − Y is the difference of currents of the frozen contract).
lean_statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (S : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (c : ℝ), (∀ y : Euclid (N + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) y) ≤ c) → ∀ x : Euclid N, covectorEuclideanNorm ((S ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → ∃ cyl : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), cyl X ω = X (S ω)) ∧ (cyl X).mass ≤ X.mass) ∧ ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → Y.mass < ∞ → cyl (X - Y) = cyl X - cyl Y
